newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer to sell $175 million in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer to sell $175 million in junk bonds.

text.p: NEW YORK, June 6 - Pioneer Cos Inc is planning to sell $175 million of 10-year senior secured notes in a 144A private placement, according to a confidential prospectus on the offering.

Net proceeds from the transaction will be used to finance the acquisition of a chemical plant in Tacoma, Wash., for $102.5 million as well as to purchase $135 million in outstanding 13-3/8 percent first mortgage notes due 2005
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Salomon Brothers Inc will underwrite the offering. The notes will be issued by Pioneer Americas Acquisition Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary.
Pioneer Co Inc is a Houston-based manufacturer and distributer of specialty chemicals.
